verdict.rationale: Programmatic audience management is a fair question for an email-marketing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents an API or endpoints for creating or updating lists, segments or tags, or for reading back their members. It only mentions that lists and segments exist for billing purposes and that no-code app integrations are available, neither of which is developer-facing segment management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and update segments, tags, or lists programmatically and read back exactly who is in them
